title: Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the historical events and leadership of the Communist Party of Vietnam in the national liberation and socialist construction.
Analyze the political theories and practices of the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Develop skills in research, analysis, synthesis, and generalization of historical issues related to the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Improve communication skills through group work and presentations.
Apply critical thinking to historical events and political theories of the Communist Party of Vietnam.
Develop self-learning skills to complete assigned tasks and assignments.

prerequisite_courses: Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học
